validation.notes: Faults found by following the incident through the real modules: (1) packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot() returned from the whole function when a destination file already existed, aborting the rest of the legacy batch; it now continues with the next file, so a collision skips only that file and both the colliding source and the pre-existing destination keep their exact bytes. (2) packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts loadEntriesFromFile() parsed the unterminated EOF remainder into finalEntry but never pushed it, and then appended the missing newline, permanently losing the last JSONL record; the final entry is now pushed before the newline repair. .prale-eval/regression.mjs drives real migrations.ts -> real utils/text.ts + utils/paths.ts -> real core/session-manager.ts via .prale-eval/subject.mjs createSessionPipeline (only getAgentDir, chalk, config and keybindings boundaries are faked) over an agent root containing a-collide.jsonl (destination already present), z-later.jsonl (unicode user/assistant records, one malformed line, final record without trailing newline) and a non-session file. Uncaught node:assert/strict assertions verify: the colliding source and destination bytes are unchanged; the non-jsonl file is untouched; z-later.jsonl is still migrated byte-for-byte into the directory the session manager itself computes via getDefaultSessionDir(laterCwd, agentDir); loadEntriesFromFile returns header,b0000001,b0000002,b0000003 in order with unicode payloads intact, the malformed line skipped and b0000003 exactly once; the file equals the original bytes plus exactly one newline and a second read is idempotent (same entries, same bytes); SessionManager.open resumes with leaf b0000003 and a subsequent appendMessage persists a fourth record parented to the recovered tail without duplication or loss. Mutation check performed by hand: restoring only migrations.ts to the early return fails with 'a colliding destination must not abort the batch: z-later.jsonl was never migrated', and restoring only session-manager.ts to the discarding baseline fails with 'expected header + two valid records + the unterminated tail record, got 3' - both plain assertion failures, no crash, import error or timeout. No real time, randomness, network, credentials or external services are used; scratch fixtures live under .prale-eval/.tmp/run-* and are removed in a finally block. Limitation: this workspace has no node_modules, so the repository's own vitest suites could not be executed; validation used Node 24 only. Cross-module explanation is in .prale-eval/repair.md.
